events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: 30 years since the passing of Tupac Shakur. His music and message continue to resonate. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix today. His guitar work changed music forever. Which track showcases his genius best for you?

events.title: The Beatles released Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released in 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album, that cover... pure iconic. What's your top track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the rock icon Chrissie Hynde! What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine'
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod in 2001, changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago, Apple dropped a game-changer that put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: A global celebration of the iconic James Bond film franchise.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and which Bond theme song is the ultimate classic? Licence to thrill us with your answers!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your go-to track from this legendary double LP?

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy... truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Queen song?

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
